item.title: Subedaar: Anurag Kashyap Impressed by Anil Kapoor Starrer
item.description: Subedaar: Bollywood veteran Anil Kapoor's film " Subedaar " was released directly on Amazon Prime Video on March 5, 2026, in which he plays retired Army Subedar Arjun Maurya. The film has received mixed reviews. Now, filmmaker Anurag Kashyap has also given his opinion on the film. Anurag Kashyap particularly praised the film's grounded treatment, raw energy, and realism of the action, which makes it feel like a theatrical experience despite its OTT debut.
